title: Reference every WMBT from at least one feature

facts.note: The invariant applies whenever the plan contains any WMBT file; WMBT files and feature files are identifiable by file kind in the plan tree.
Any planning or plan-validation pass over a plan containing WMBT files; the invariant is whole-plan, so it applies to pre-existing orphans too, not only to newly changed files.
Validator result surfaced as a finding.

fires: The plan contains a WMBT file that no feature's wmbts list names, including orphans that pre-exist the current change.
The plan contains WMBT files but no features at all.
A feature exists but declares no wmbts list, leaving WMBT files unreferenced.
Example changes that commonly create orphans: adding a WMBT without listing it, renaming a WMBT while features keep the old name, editing or removing a feature's wmbts list or removing a feature.
doesNotFire: Every WMBT file in the plan is named in at least one feature's wmbts list.
A feature listing WMBTs beyond the minimum (the rule only checks the wmbt -> feature direction).
The plan contains no WMBT files.

given: The plan contains one or more WMBT files.
when: You author, change or validate the plan.
then: Every WMBT file must appear in at least one feature's wmbts list (wmbt -> feature coverage).
prefer: When authoring a WMBT, add it in the same change to the wmbts list of the feature it serves.
When splitting, renaming or removing a feature, re-home each of its WMBTs into another feature's wmbts list.
avoid: Orphan WMBT files that no feature references, whether new or pre-existing.
Gaming coverage by dumping unrelated WMBTs into an arbitrary or catch-all feature's wmbts list just to satisfy the check.
why: A WMBT that no feature references is untraceable to user-facing value and falls outside wagon/feature coverage; wmbt -> feature coverage is the link that lets lower-level coverage (WMBT -> acceptance) roll up to features and wagons.
evidence: Validator test_all_wmbts_in_at_least_one_feature passes: every WMBT file appears in at least one feature's wmbts list.
Reviewer can map each WMBT file in the plan to a feature whose wmbts list names it.
verifier_detail: Bidirectional direction checked: wmbt -> feature. Requirement: Every WMBT file must appear in at least one feature's wmbts list. Validator: test_all_wmbts_in_at_least_one_feature.
Term wmbt_feature_coverage: every WMBT file appears in at least one feature's wmbts list.
